contentList.content: Mysterious rogues who master shadow powers, able to conceal themselves at will like silent phantoms. Gain permanent invisibility ability at 3rd level, allowing free switching between visible and invisible states in combat.

Merge with shadows to gain greater invisibility. Use again to end the effect. While invisible, gain movement speed bonus and advantage on Dexterity saving throws, but attacking or casting spells will end invisibility.
Mastered advanced shadow techniques, unlocking the Shadow Stealth ability. Movement speed increases while invisible, with extended duration.
Deep fusion with shadows grants resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. Take half damage from necrotic or psychic sources.
While invisible, you can make one attack without ending invisibility, and attacks deal additional necrotic damage.
Become a true master of shadows. Reduced invisibility cooldown, advantage on all attacks while invisible, and regain one spell slot per long rest.
